versions.changelog:
- Added homepage and metadata fields to SKILL.md for enhanced integration and discoverability.
- Included Openclaw-specific metadata (emoji, supported OS, required binaries).
- No changes to the skill logic or API.

Major update: Introduces a new resource-based construction cost estimation system with extended transparency and flexibility.

- Implements separation of resource consumption norms from resource prices for accurate and adjustable cost estimation.
- Adds definitions for resources, resource norms, and work items, supporting all major construction cost components.
- Supports input and management via pandas DataFrames for integration with existing data.
- Calculates detailed cost breakdowns (labor, material, equipment, subcontractor) and generates project summaries.
- Includes customizable overhead and profit rates in total cost estimation.
- Enables selective resource price adjustments by type for rapid scenario analysis.

- Initial release of the Cost Estimation Resource skill.
- Supports transparent, resource-based construction cost estimation.
- Calculates costs from work items, physical resource norms, and current unit prices.
- Separates costing into labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor components.
- Allows for customizable overhead and profit rates in total cost calculation.
